Class TotemChoiceController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.Controllers.PreGame.TotemChoiceController
public class TotemChoiceController extends Object
Controller for the totem choice screen. Allows the player to select a color totem before creating or joining a game. Displays which totems are already taken by other players and updates in real time when the lobby data changes.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      void initialize()
      Loads all totem images, builds the parallel slot and color lists, disables the confirm button and registers mouse event handlers on all slots.

    • setController

      public void setController(ClientController clientController, SceneManager sceneManager)
      Injects dependencies into this controller.
      Parameters:
      clientController - the client controller used to create or join a game
      sceneManager - the scene manager used for change the scene when create/join game

    • setParameter

      public void setParameter(int id, int numPlayers, LobbyInfoDTO dto)
      Sets the parameters for this screen depending on whether the player is creating a new game or joining an existing one. Updates the confirm button text accordingly.
      Parameters:
      id - -1 if creating a new game, the actual game id if joining
      numPlayers - the number of players for the new game, used only in create mode
      dto - the lobby data for the game being joined, or null in create mode

    • updateDTO

      public void updateDTO(List<LobbyInfoDTO> lobby)
      Updates the lobby data for this screen when another player picks a color. Searches the updated lobby list for the game matching the current dto id. If the data has not changed, no refresh is performed. If the game is now full, shows an error message and redirects to the lobby after 2 seconds. Otherwise, refreshes the totem slots to reflect the updated color availability.
      Parameters:
      lobby - the updated list of all lobbies received from the server

    • setupEvents

      private void setupEvents()
      Registers hover and click mouse event handlers on all totem slots. Hovering over a free unselected slot highlights it in green. Clicking a taken slot shows a red flash via showTaken. Clicking a free slot selects its color and triggers a full refresh.

    • refresh

      private void refresh()
      Refreshes the visual state of all totem slots. Taken slots are shown as dark. The selected slot is highlighted in bright green with a white border. Free unselected slots are shown in neutral dark gray. Also updates the confirm button enabled state.

    • isTaken

      private boolean isTaken(Color color)
      Returns whether the given color has already been taken by another player.
      Parameters:
      color - the color to check
      Returns:
      true if the color is present in the dto's taken colors list, false otherwise

    • showTaken

      private void showTaken(javafx.scene.layout.StackPane slot)
      Briefly highlights a totem slot in red to indicate it is already taken. The slot will return to its normal state on the next refresh call.
      Parameters:
      slot - the slot to highlight in red

    • updateButtonState

      private void updateButtonState()
      Enables the confirm button only if a color has been selected. Disables it if colorChoice is null.

    • showMessage

    • handleCreate_JoinGame

      public void handleCreate_JoinGame()
      Handles the create or join game button action. If no color has been selected, shows an error message and returns. Disables the button immediately to prevent double clicks while waiting for the server response. The scene transition to the waiting room is triggered automatically by updateClientState when the server confirms the join. If the server rejects the request (e.g. game full or color taken), the button is re-enabled and an error message is shown.
